title: fix: gRPC registration UI fixes
summary:
## 🔗 Related Issue

Addresses #2854 

---

## 📝 Summary

This PR fixes the flow when submitting the registration form for a gRPC service in the UI. Key changes:

* Add `handleGrpcServiceFormSubmit` in `admin.js` and bind it to the `add-grpc-service-form` form in `admin.html`
* Fix form submission action for `add-grpc-service-form` in `admin.html`
* Fix URL for `admin/grpc` in `viewGrpcMethods`
* Add missing `grpcFormError` in `admin.html`

---
